promise: Apple Vision Pro... will be available early next year
description: Apple announced Vision Pro on June 5, 2023, starting at $3,499 with US availability planned for early 2024. On January 8, 2024 it announced February 2 US availability.
evidence: Apple's launch announcement specifies early-2024 US availability.

review.note: Original promise was early 2024 in US; February 29 is not an explicit cutoff. Official sources support $3,499 and February 2 scheduled availability; remove unsupported review/sales assessment. Actual retail launch confirmation remains separate from January forward announcement.
